title: The cotype–cotype conjecture under the approximation property

result.label: The cotype–cotype conjecture under the approximation property
result.statement: Resolves the cotype–cotype conjecture for real Banach spaces with the approximation property. Such a nonzero space is K -convex if and only if both it and its dual have finite Rademacher cotype, with possibly different exponents. Equivalently, these cotype assumptions force nontrivial Rademacher type.
